items.title: 31.8 Nuclear energy - fission aur fusion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear and solar energy (PDF 228-230).

blocks.text: Fossil fuels aur un ke nuqsan-deh asraat ke ilawa, nuclear energy aik ahem aur ummeed-afza zariya hai jo duniya ki barhti tawanai ki zaruriyat poori karne mein madad de sakta hai. Nuclear energy atoms ke nuclei se nikalne wali tawanai hai, jab bhari nuclei toote hain (fission) ya halke nuclei jurte hain (fusion). Yeh reactions kimiyai reactions ke muqable bohat zyada tawanai chhorte hain.

Fission woh amal hai jis mein uranium-235 ya plutonium-239 jaisa bhari nucleus do halke nuclei mein toot'ta hai, aur tawanai, neutrons aur radiation paida hoti hai. Paida hone wale neutrons mazeed fission kara sakte hain, jise chain reaction kehte hain. Uranium-235 aur neutron ka reaction: U-235 + n -> Ba-141 + Kr-92 + 3n + tawanai.

Nuclear bijli ghar bijli banane ke liye fission wasee taur par use karte hain, aur thore se fuel se bohat zyada tawanai lete hain. Lekin is ki sangeen khamiyan hain. Yeh radioactive kachra paida karta hai jise lambe arse tak ehtiyat se sambhalna parta hai, aur nuclear haadsaat ka khatra hai, jaise Chernobyl (1986) aur Fukushima (2011); in haadsaat ne mahol aur insani sehat ko sakht nuqsan pohanchaya. Fusion, halke nuclei ka jurna, bhi bohat zyada tawanai chhorta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: 2011 mein Japan mein bare zalzale aur tsunami ne Fukushima mein reactor ke haadsaat paida kiye. Radioactive ikhraj ki wajah se 150,000 se zyada logon ko nikala gaya, aur duniya ko aafat-zada ilaqon mein nuclear plants ki hifazat ki fikr hui.

blocks.alt: Oopar: neutron uranium-235 nucleus se takrata hai, jo tawanai ke saath barium-141 aur krypton-92 mein toot'ta hai; teen neutrons nikalte aur har aik doosre uranium-235 nucleus se takrata hai (chain reaction). Neeche equation 235U + 1n -> 141Ba + 92Kr + 3 1n + tawanai likhi hai. Sab se neeche: do chhote nuclei jur kar aik bara nucleus banate aur tawanai chhorte hain (fusion).
blocks.caption: Nuclear fission aur fusion (topic 31.8 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aik neutron aik nucleus torta lekin teen mazeed neutrons chhorta hai, is liye fission ki tadaad tezi se barh sakti hai: yahi chain reaction hai. Fusion mein ulat hota hai: chhote nuclei jur kar bara nucleus banate hain.

blocks.text: Solar photovoltaic (PV) system aik saaf tawanai ka nizam hai. Is ke solar panels, jo aam taur par silicon semiconducting materials se bane hote hain, dhoop ki tawanai ko photovoltaic effect se bijli mein badalte hain: roshni material mein electrons ko mutaharrik karti, jis se direct current (DC) banta hai. Inverter is DC ko alternating current (AC) mein badalta hai, jo gharon, schoolon, daftaron aur sanaton ko bijli de sakta hai. Nizam mein raat ya abr-alood dinon ke liye bijli jama karne wali batteries bhi hoti hain; yeh voltage mustahkam rakhne aur achanak zyada current (surge current) dene mein bhi madad karti hain. Bijli ke lawazimat, taarein, appliances aur dhanche poore nizam ko kaarguzar aur mehfooz banate hain.

blocks.alt: Suraj neele silicon solar panel par chamakta hai. Andar ka khaaka cell ki tahein dikhata: oopar (-) tah, junction (diode) aur neeche (+) tah, azad electrons ke saath. Taar direct current inverter tak le jati, jo alternating current lamp ko bhejta, gharon, schoolon, daftaron aur sanat ke liye. DC line se juri battery raat aur abr-alood dinon ke liye tawanai jama karti aur voltage mustahkam rakhti.
blocks.caption: Solar PV nizam kaise kaam karta hai (Figure 31.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Roshni do silicon tahon ke junction par electrons azad karti hai, is liye panel direct current deta hai. Inverter ise aam appliances ke alternating current mein badalta hai, aur battery dhoop na hone ka waqt poora karti hai.

blocks.text: Solar energy ke riwayati zaraye par ahem faide hain. Yeh mahol dost aur qabil-e-tajdeed (renewable) hai, is liye mausami tabdeeli aur mahol ki aaloodgi ke khilaf jang mein madad deti hai. Solar panels lambe arse mein kifayati bhi hain, kyunke lagne ke baad kam dekh-bhaal mangte hain. Tawanai ki qillat, fuel ki buland qeematein aur mausami masail batate hain ke hamein solar, pani (hydro) aur hawa (wind) jaise qabil-e-tajdeed zaraye ki taraf jana chahiye.

blocks.caption: Tawanai ke zaraye ka muqabla (is chapter se)
rows: Bohat kaarguzar; zyada energy density; petrochemicals dete
Qabil-e-tajdeed nahi; jalne se CO2: hawa ki aaloodgi, global warming, mausami tabdeeli
Thore fuel se bohat zyada tawanai
Radioactive kachra jise lambi dekh-bhaal chahiye; haadsaat ka khatra (Chernobyl, Fukushima)
Saaf aur qabil-e-tajdeed; lambe arse mein kifayati; kam dekh-bhaal
Raat aur abr-alood dinon ke liye batteries chahiye

blocks.prompt: Bohat se solar energy nizamon mein batteries kyun shamil hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Raat ya abr-alood dinon ke liye bijli jama karne, aur voltage mustahkam rakhne aur surge current dene ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Bijli banane ke ilawa nuclear fission aur kahan use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Maslan kuch abdozon (submarines) aur jahazon ko chalane, research reactors mein tibb aur tehqeeq ke liye radioactive isotopes banane, aur nuclear hathiyaron mein.

blocks.prompt: Ghaib products pehchanein: U-235 + n -> ___ + ___ + 3n + tawanai.
blocks.explanation: Barium-141 aur krypton-92 (matan mein diya reaction); mass numbers barabar: 235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3.

blocks.prompt: Nuclear reactions kimiyai reactions se kaheen zyada tawanai kyun chhorte hain?
blocks.explanation: Nuclear reactions khud nucleus ko badalte hain, jahan bohat taqatwar quwwatein zarrat ko jore rakhti hain, aur thori si kamiyat (mass) bohat zyada tawanai mein badalti hai; kimiyai reactions sirf bonds mein bairooni electrons ki tarteeb badalte hain.

items: Fission: bhari nucleus toot'ta; neutrons chain reaction chalate.
Fission ki khamiyan: radioactive kachra, haadsaat.
Solar PV: silicon cells DC dete; inverter AC deta; batteries tawanai jama karti.
